description: Hand-placed edge cases for the five detection rules, including three known misses. Not a sample of real activity.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Four failed sign-ins, then a success: one short of the threshold.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: Five failed sign-ins, the first exactly 30 minutes before the success.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: As B-02, but the first failure is 30 minutes and 1 second before the success.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: Five failed sign-ins from five different addresses, then a success.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Five failed sign-ins by one account, then a success by a different account.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: An unapproved grant, then a restricted export exactly 60 minutes later.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: As B-06, but the export is 60 minutes and 1 second after the grant.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: An unapproved grant to one principal, then a restricted export by another.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: A sign-in at the same instant as the disable: not after it.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: A sign-in two hours after the disable, written earlier in the file than the disable.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.summary: Disabled, re-enabled without an approval reference, then a sign-in.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: The disable is recorded by a separate HR source; the sign-in three hours later by the identity provider.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: An administrative role granted without approval, where the source omits the privileged flag.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: A privileged sign-in where the source omits whether a second factor was used.

scenarios.label: suspicious
scenarios.summary: Five failed sign-ins, then two successes a minute apart.
